label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): Math.random() is indeed weak PRNG, but this is intentional test code demonstrating the pattern; not actionable vuln. Alert 2 (java/xss): User-controlled cookie value flows directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding - classic XSS. The cookie value from client can contain arbitrary characters including <script> tags that execute in victim's browser.

evidence.note: Cookie value retrieved from client and printed to response without HTML encoding - XSS vulnerability
